holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.33% weight, KVB added an estimated 0.345% to returns over 3 months behind a 14.8% gain.

watch.text: Credit growth tracking toward the targeted 18-20% band while corporate lending stays capped at 20%.

holdings.why_it_matters: Gland Pharma was the largest single contributor over 3 months (+0.563% estimated) supported by a 24.27% share price return at a 2.32% fund weight.

holdings.why_it_matters: City Union Bank carries a 2.24% weight in the portfolio, which maintains a 22.5% concentration in the Financials sector.

expected.text: CEO Ajai Shukla stated that the company sees a 5 to 8 basis points NIM gain from an RBI rate hike.

holdings.why_it_matters: Affle carries a 1.95% weight and detracted an estimated -0.121% from the fund over 3 months after falling -6.19%.

holdings.name: Ajanta Pharma Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue grew to Rs 1,626 crore in June 2026 from Rs 1,303 crore in June 2025, with net profit rising to Rs 334 crore from Rs 255 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Ajanta Pharma accounts for 1.94% of fund assets and pairs with Gland Pharma inside the fund's 12.2% Healthcare weighting.

portfolio.statement: Canara Robeco Small Cap Fund holds Rs 13,972 crore in AUM with 96% equity allocation, concentrated primarily in Financials (22.5%) and Industrials (21.0%).
interp: The portfolio maintains a low top-10 concentration of 23.3%, diversifying stock-specific risk across smaller allocations.
Recent 3-month performance was supported by strong gains in Gland Pharma and MCX, balancing out cyclical drawdowns in consumer discretionary names.
portfolio.line: Performance is driven by private credit expansion, exchange trading volumes, and overseas pharmaceutical acquisitions against consumer discretionary headwinds.

drivers.text: Healthcare performance was led by Gland Pharma's 24.27% 3-month gain following steady earnings and the USD 21 million Novelstar acquisition approval.
Financials performance was bolstered by MCX's 15.09% 3-month return, Karur Vysya Bank's 37% YoY Q2 profit rise, and RBL Bank securing RBI approval for its Emirates NBD branch amalgamation.
